assets.name: Freezer Horizontal
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE isolated commercial equipment illustration for the approved Cogna business game, EQUIPMENT_FREEZER_HORIZONTAL.
Input images: Image 1 is the current catalog sprite, equipment content/topology reference ONLY; remove its enclosing metallic card, frame, opaque background and photographic finish. Image 2 is the approved Cogna management concept, adult equipment cartoon style, camera and light reference ONLY; never copy its UI, labels, people, status badges or prices. Image 3 is the completed ART-20 workbench, shared clean contour, slate-gray materials, front-right camera and upper-left lighting reference ONLY; never add a workbench to the requested asset. Furniture keeps its natural wood and dark frame; the PDV kit keeps its dark plastic and slate hardware.
Primary request: ONE commercial horizontal chest freezer with a broad low rectangular body, ONE closed solid top-hinged lid, a simple horizontal front handle and tiny mechanical key cylinder beneath it, a neat dark gasket line around the lid, a small low ventilation grille on its visible RIGHT side and four short dark feet. Preserve the content of the current catalog source, changing its left-side camera to the family front-right camera. Matte light gray steel body, medium slate right side, restrained pale lid highlight. The lid is fully shut; freezer is empty from view. No glass lid, transparent door, open lid, food, frost, ice, cable, display text, power labels, stickers or branding.
Composition/camera: SQUARE 1:1 source, desired 1024x1024, final export 512x512, display 250x250 contain. One complete object or one equipment set centered, occupying about 80 percent of the source width and height with at least 10 percent genuinely transparent margin on every side. Full silhouette uncropped, including every foot, rim, handle and backsplash. Shared front-right three-quarter camera: broad FRONT face and narrower RIGHT side visible, top surfaces visible, verticals upright, viewer slightly above worktop height. No mirrored left-side camera, flat front view, top-down diagram, extreme wide-angle lens or toy-like distortion. Stable frame and comparable visual scale for the family, preserving realistic industrial proportions.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn adult editorial cartoon matching the equipment illustrations in the approved Cogna management concept. Confident muted dark-plum #30243C/#24113D contours, clean controlled cel shading, matte stainless/slate gray in TWO or THREE broad tonal regions per part, dark charcoal hardware. The main steel faces are light neutral-cool gray, right sides medium slate gray, small recesses dark slate. Soft upper-left lighting; restrained broad pale highlights only on upper-left edges. No photoreal brushed grain, mirror chrome, noisy textures, painterly mottling, plastic 3D rendering, heavy black comic outlines or tiny illegible mechanical details. Purple is a restrained gray-shadow undertone, not a saturated body color. Clear readable silhouette and internal structure at 250x250.
Transparency: genuine RGBA cutout, alpha zero everywhere outside the equipment silhouette and inside open gaps between legs or handles. Solid visually opaque equipment interior, clean antialiased outline. No backdrop, wall, floor, plinth, pedestal, connected ground patch, outside cast shadow, wide drop shadow, colored halo, glow or haze. No fake transparency checkerboard.
Constraints: exactly ONE catalog equipment asset per image, never a sprite sheet, complete UI card or multi-view collage. No people, hands, labels, letters, words, numbers, prices, purchase status, premium badges, locks, ticks, cart icons, logos, invented branding, frame, border, rounded square backplate, cream field or UI overlay. Never copy the source's enclosing metallic frame, opaque background or photographic finish. No detached prop, scene or object not specified. No crop or shadow outside the silhouette.
assets.visual_composition_proposal: Freezer horizontal de tampa única fechada, puxador frontal, pequeno cilindro mecânico, grelha de ventilação lateral e pés curtos, adaptado à câmera frontal de três quartos com lado direito visível.
